text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I guess Sakura Bakushin O takes it today.
When it comes to sprints, she's the one.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "No, but today's real highlight was definitely the height difference between Biko Pegasus and Hishi Akebono!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The news was totally hyping it up as a clash
of opposites, you know? So I brought my camera.

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people.
It's my first time at a racetrack, so...

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Same here. Man,
I can't wait to see Buono-chan race live.

"It was a race featuring a fully primed Hishi Akebono,
yet a strangely relaxed mood hung over the stands."
Meanwhile, in the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I can't help feeling restless~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. People tell me that a lot.
Though it's true I'm pretty restless~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I got so many comments on Umastagram.
Saying things like "Good luck!" and "I'm going to watch you!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So... I wonder if I can go, like,
'hyaaah' and 'toryaaaah~'. It'd be nice if I could~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. I wonder if counting the veggies in a chankonabe will calm me down.
There's green onions, Chinese cabbage—
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono and Bono's Trainer!
We came to say hi! Let's have a great race today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Biko-chan! Yep yep,
I won't lose today! Let's do our best~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, truth is,
I'm actually a little nervous...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, seeing Bono's smile put me at ease!
That's all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Is that so? How mysterious~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, you know what?
My restlessness is completely gone now too~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Maybe it's because I got to chat with you, Biko-chan. Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What, were you feeling restless too, Bono?
...Hehe!

Exchanging a glance, the two of them
reached out their hands as if by silent agreement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not going to lose, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I won't give up either!

As the two exchanged a firm handshake—
the curtain rose on the "Sprinters Stakes"!
